properties.name: Human-approved Upper Trishuli / Bhote Koshi analytical corridor
properties.coverage_disclosure: The study corridor extends beyond the currently available valid satellite observation coverage. Approximately 63.4% of the AOI has delivered imagery coverage; the remaining 36.6% is unobserved in the current dataset. Results apply only to the observed, valid-data area. Unobserved areas must not be interpreted as unaffected, flood-free, or undamaged.
properties.note: Project-defined extent, not a flood map, competition boundary or acquisition authorization.
